UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated Jayra user account storing email, generated country phone number, country name, and profile settings.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Validated email address of the user.

fcmToken.description: Owner-isolated Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on registration.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile updates.

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: Direct or group chat metadata scoped to bounded participant UIDs.

hasTopics.description: Whether topic tabs are enabled for this group chat.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Encrypted message inside a chat room subcollection.

topicId.description: Topic identifier within topic-enabled groups (defaults to general).

forwardedFrom.description: Original sender display name when a message is forwarded.

checklistTitle.description: Optional title of an interactive checklist message.

checklistItems.description: Bounded list of checklist task objects {id, text, isDone} (max 50).

allowOthersToToggle.description: Whether chat participants other than the sender can toggle checklist items.

voiceDurationMillis.description: Trimmed voice note duration in milliseconds (100..3600000).

voiceWaveform.description: Bounded list of normalized waveform bar amplitudes [0..1] (max 80).

Community.title: Community
Community.description: Community hub grouping multiple related group chats for members.

groupIds.description: Bounded list of associated group chat IDs (max 50).

memberIds.description: Bounded list of community member UIDs (max 100).

GroupRoom.title: GroupRoom
GroupRoom.description: Group conversation configuration and bounded member list.

CallRecord.title: CallRecord
CallRecord.description: Voice or video call log owned by a specific user.

CallSignalDoc.title: CallSignalDoc
CallSignalDoc.description: Signaling state between caller and receiver.

participants.description: Bounded list of call participant UIDs (max 50).

UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Active device session belonging to an authenticated user.

AssistantMessage.title: AssistantMessage
AssistantMessage.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted AI assistant message scoped under assistant_chats/{userId}/messages.

Story.title: Story
Story.description: Ephemeral or album-saved photo story posted by an authenticated user.

ContactNote.title: ContactNote
ContactNote.description: Owner-isolated private note and birthday metadata about a specific contact.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

note.description: Private personal note about the contact.

birthdayMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds from Material3 DatePicker.

/users/{userId}.description: User account registration and profile documents isolated to owner UID.

/users/{userId}/notes/{contactId}.description: Private contact notes and birthdays strictly isolated under owner UID.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Chat rooms accessible only to participants.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Encrypted chat messages accessible only to chat participants.

/communities/{communityId}.description: Communities grouping related group chats accessible to community members.

/channels/{channelId}.description: Channels accessible to creator and subscribers.

/calls/{callId}.description: Call history logs isolated per user.

/call_signals/{callId}.description: WebRTC/call signaling documents restricted to caller and receiver.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Active device sessions isolated per user.

/assistant_chats/{userId}/messages/{mess.description: Encrypted AI assistant history isolated under owner UID.

/stories/{storyId}.description: Story albums and photo stories readable by authenticated users and authored by owner UID.
